full_text:
Article 9 (Requests for Secondment of Public Officials, etc.)
(1) Where necessary for the operation of the Committee, etc., the Committee may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and local governments, or the heads of relevant agencies, corporations or organizations, to second public officials or employees under their jurisdiction or to have them serve concurrently.
(2) Where necessary for the performance of its duties, the Committee may appoint experts in relevant fields as fixed-term public officials under Article 26-5 of the State Public Officials Act, within budgetary limits.
